content.summary: A radio host uses braid arcs and lemon graphics to loop from ZEST back to ZEST. Preserve the five causal invariants and terminal proof while replacing every source-specific surface.

quick_start.input_format: At least three identity anchors remain fixed. + Character motion physically motivates each graphic handoff. + One exact short word appears per typography module. + Foreground hair or costume motion performs the wipes. + The opening graphic motif returns with the full character.
quick_start.recommended_input: Establish one original adult animated radio host with cobalt braids, silver jacket and one lemon badge against the exact title ZEST. Alternate three full-body rhythm poses with lemon circles and the exact short word TUNE. Return to the exact ZEST field around the complete host and hold one confident final pose.
